newsitem.title: THAILAND: Poor Thai villagers end marathon Bangkok protest.
newsitem.headline: Poor Thai villagers end marathon Bangkok protest.

text.p: Thousands of poor Thai villagers from the impoverished northeast who have camped outside Government House in Bangkok for three months seeking social justice ended their marathon protest on Friday.

A spokesman for the Assembly of Poor, as the protest organisers are called, said the 15,000 protesters who had demanded settlement of their land disputes with the government and better farm produce prices, were ready to trek home.
"We are happy with the government response and are ready to return home later today," spokesman Viraphol Sopha told reporters.

The government had agreed this week to established a central fund valued at about two billion baht ($80 million) to compensate those protesters who could prove they had lost their farmland because of government projects.

"Representatives from the Assembly met with Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh today and told him they would end the protest and return home later today," government spokesman Warathep Rattankorn told Reuters.
